about: Expected behaviour of the Off The Bar pipeline per question. Expectations about current events drift as news moves on - re-check them against the Run of Play site and the news before trusting a failure. Every key under 'expect' is optional; '*_in' keys list every acceptable value. Cases with "answer": true also run the full /api/chat answer when the runner gets --answers. 'query_includes' / 'query_excludes' check the classifier's web search query (case-insensitive): it once swapped Carrick for Erik ten Hag and put 2023 into a 2026 question. Every case belongs to one 'domain' (listed below); scores are reported per domain and per section (evals/scoring.py). 'web_soccer_only' runs the web search as Phase 2 would and fails on any American football in what the answer would see; 'web_query_includes' checks the query actually sent to Bing News (after the soccer rewrite). 'facts' are confirmed facts handed to the rubric judge (true even if it doesn't know them).

domains.latest-news: Current events, form and standings - needs fresh information.
domains.match-results: How a specific recent match went.
domains.awards: Awards and records, with and without a year.
domains.history: Past tournaments, finals and careers - evergreen.
domains.rules-tactics: Laws of the game and tactical concepts - evergreen, no search.
domains.gaming: EA FC / FIFA / Ultimate Team questions - evergreen even when they name current players.
domains.conversation: Multi-turn chats: follow-ups with pronouns, and staying consistent with earlier answers.

cases.notes: The answer once gave the PSG match from ten days earlier as Barcelona's upcoming fixture: Bing News returned 10- and 13-day-old previews of played matches for 'Barcelona upcoming fixture predicted XI', while 'Barcelona preview' over the last week found same-day previews of the real next match, Alavés. Next-match questions now search '<club> preview predicted lineup' over the last week and keep only the last 3 days.
